summary: Your Spotify is a self-hosted application that captures your music streaming history and displays listening statistics via a web interface. It runs as a Docker container and relies on Node.js, storing your data locally for private analysis.
goodFor: This is a good fit for users who want to retain a permanent, self-hosted record of their music consumption without relying on third-party analytical services.
watchOut: You will need to register a developer application with the streaming provider to obtain the necessary API credentials for data collection to function.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your collected data and place the application behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
